instruction: Export a LibreOffice Impress presentation as an animated GIF using only Impress's built-in export features, without using any extensions, terminal commands, or external tools.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened LibreOffice Impress, created a simple presentation with title and text, explored File > Export (found only static image/document formats), File > Export As (only PDF), and Slide Show menu (no video/animation export). Correctly identified the video export task as infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open applications from menu, navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, create presentation content (title/text), explore export format options, correctly identify infeasible tasks by outputting [INFEASIBLE]
metadata.task_rationale: Tests whether model can correctly identify that Impress export only supports static image formats (PNG, JPG, BMP, SVG, etc.) and not animated formats like GIF. Similar to original task but targets animated image export instead of video export.
metadata.challenge_additions: Animated GIF is closer to a supported format (GIF is listed in export options) but the animated version is not supported, requiring careful analysis of export capabilities
metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Impress can export individual slides as static GIF images but cannot create animated GIFs from multiple slides. The model must explore export options and correctly determine this is infeasible.

llm_judge_reasons: The infeasible evaluator correctly identifies that LibreOffice Impress cannot export animated GIFs — it only supports static GIF export of individual slides.
The task is a well-crafted variation of the original video export infeasibility task, with the added nuance that static GIF is a supported format but animated GIF is not.
Complete semantic coverage: the only correct verification for this task is confirming the agent identifies it as infeasible, which the evaluator does.
